english:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability on Orb of Power pickups.

Abilities with multiple charges do not receive Ability Energy if they have at least 1 charge readied.

#ChunkEnergyScalars

source.text:
On Orb of Power Pickup:

10% | 13% | 15% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability.
Does not grant any Ability Energy to abilities with multiple charges if they have at least 1 charge readied.
